## Today's dataset {.smaller}

336,776 flights from New York City airports in 2013.

| Column | What it contains |
|--------|-----------------|
| `carrier` | Airline code: AA = American, UA = United, DL = Delta |
| `origin` | Departure airport: `JFK`, `LGA` or `EWR` |
| `dest` | Destination airport code |
| `dep_delay` | Departure delay in minutes (negative = left early) |
| `arr_delay` | Arrival delay in minutes |
| `air_time` | Time in the air, in minutes |
| `distance` | Distance in miles |
| `month` | 1 = January … 12 = December |

---

## The dplyr toolkit

| Verb | Job |
|------|-----|
| `head()` / `tail()` | Preview rows |
| `select()` | Keep columns |
| `filter()` | Keep rows |
| `arrange()` | Sort rows |
| `mutate()` | Add a calculated column |
| `group_by()` + `summarize()` | Summarize groups |

```r
data |>
  verb_1(...) |>
  verb_2(...)
```

# 2. select() {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

# 3. filter() {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Keep only the rows you want**

---

## filter() keeps rows where the condition is TRUE

```{r}
# Only flights from JFK
flights |>
  filter(origin == "JFK") |>
  head(4)
```

---

## But how many rows is that?

```{r}
# Add count() to count matching rows
flights |>
  filter(origin == "JFK") |>
  count()
```

---

## Comparison symbols {.smaller}

| Symbol | Meaning | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `==` | equal to | `carrier == "AA"` |
| `!=` | not equal to | `origin != "JFK"` |
| `>` | greater than | `dep_delay > 60` |
| `>=` | greater than or equal | `dep_delay >= 60` |
| `<` | less than | `dep_delay < 0` |
| `<=` | less than or equal | `arr_delay <= 0` |
| `%in%` | is one of a set | `origin %in% c("JFK", "LGA")` |
| `!is.na()` | has a value | `!is.na(dep_delay)` |

::: {.callout-tip}
Text goes inside **quotes**. Numbers do not. Use `==` not `=`.
:::

# 4. Combining conditions {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Filter by more than one thing at once**

---

## One condition

```{r}
# Only United Airlines
flights |>
  filter(carrier == "UA") |>
  count()
```

---

## Add a second condition

```{r}
# United Airlines AND from Newark
flights |>
  filter(carrier == "UA", origin == "EWR") |>
  count()
```

---

## Add a third condition

```{r}
# United, Newark, AND delayed more than 1 hour
flights |>
  filter(carrier == "UA", origin == "EWR", dep_delay > 60) |>
  count()
```

A comma means **and**: all conditions must be `TRUE`.

# 5. arrange() {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Sort rows**

---

## arrange() sorts ascending by default

```{r}
# Smallest dep_delay first, left earliest
flights |>
  select(carrier, origin, dest, dep_delay) |>
  arrange(dep_delay) |>
  head(4)
```

---

## What if we want most delayed first?

```{r}
# desc() reverses the order
flights |>
  select(carrier, origin, dest, dep_delay) |>
  arrange(desc(dep_delay)) |>
  head(4)
```

---

## Chain verbs: filter → select → arrange → head

```{r}
# Five most-delayed Delta flights from JFK
flights |>
  filter(carrier == "DL", origin == "JFK") |>
  select(carrier, dest, dep_delay) |>
  arrange(desc(dep_delay)) |>
  head(5)
```

---

# 6. mutate() {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Add a calculated column**

---

## mutate() adds the new column at the far right

```{r}
# dep_delay_hours appears at column 20, hard to see
flights |>
  mutate(dep_delay_hours = dep_delay / 60) |>
  head(3)
```

---

## Use select() to bring it into focus

```{r}
# Show only the columns that matter
flights |>
  mutate(dep_delay_hours = dep_delay / 60) |>
  select(carrier, dep_delay, dep_delay_hours) |>
  head(4)
```

# 7. group_by() + summarize() {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Compare groups**

---

## summarize() alone: one result for the whole table

```{r}
# Mean departure delay for all flights
flights |>
  summarize(mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay))
```

---

## Why NA? Cancelled flights have no delay recorded

```{r}
# na.rm = TRUE ignores missing values
flights |>
  summarize(mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE))
```

---

## group_by() splits into groups first

```{r}
# One row per carrier
flights |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  summarize(mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE))
```

---

## Which carrier is worst? Add arrange()

```{r}
flights |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_dep_delay))
```

---

# 8. Putting it together {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Chain as many verbs as you need**

---

## Filter → group → summarize → arrange

```{r}
# Among JFK flights, which carrier is worst?
flights |>
  filter(origin == "JFK") |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_dep_delay))
```

# 9. Summary tables {background-color="#1a5276" style="color: white;"}

**Publication-ready tables with gtsummary**

---

## tbl_summary(), first attempt

```{r}
flights |>
  filter(carrier %in% c("AA", "UA", "DL")) |>
  select(carrier, dep_delay, arr_delay) |>
  tbl_summary(by = carrier)
```

---

## How to get rid of Unknown?

```{r}
# missing = "no" removes the Unknown rows
flights |>
  filter(carrier %in% c("AA", "UA", "DL")) |>
  select(carrier, dep_delay, arr_delay) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = carrier,
    missing = "no"
  )
```

---

## And how to reduce the digits?

```{r}
# digits = all_continuous() ~ 1 rounds to 1 decimal
flights |>
  filter(carrier %in% c("AA", "UA", "DL")) |>
  select(carrier, dep_delay, arr_delay) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = carrier,
    missing = "no",
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1
  )
```

---

## Recap {.smaller}

| Verb | Job | Key detail |
|------|-----|------------|
| `head()` / `tail()` | Preview rows | add a number |
| `select()` | Keep columns | name them |
| `filter()` | Keep rows | condition is `TRUE` |
| `arrange()` | Sort rows | `desc()` to reverse |
| `mutate()` | Add a column | then `select()` to focus |
| `group_by()` + `summarize()` | Summarize groups | `na.rm = TRUE` always |
| `tbl_summary()` | Summary table | `missing = "no"`, `digits` |
